title: How to Hear God’s Voice Every Day
titleZh: 每天如何聆聽神的聲音
summaryZh: 與人建立立約的關係，能使你共同領受他人的突破與神同在的恩膏。
lines: All right, Numbers 11, let's get into the word here. Verse 24, we're going to read a number of verses here.
好了，民數記11章，讓我們來看看這段經文。第24節，我們要讀好幾節經文。
Verse 24: Moses went out, told the people the words of the Lord, he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and placed them around the tabernacle.
第24節：摩西出去，將耶和華的話告訴百姓；他招聚了百姓的長老中七十個人，安置在會幕的四圍。
The tabernacle is where the presence of God was manifest, so they surrounded the presence.
會幕是神同在彰顯的地方，所以他們圍繞著神的同在。
The Lord came down in the cloud and spoke to him, and took the Spirit that was upon him, and placed the same upon the seventy elders.
耶和華在雲中降臨，對他說話，把降與他身上的靈分賜那七十個長老。
And it happened, when the Spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, although they never did so again.
靈停在他們身上的時候，他們就受感說話，以後卻沒有再說。
Verse 26: Two men had remained in the camp; the name of one was Eldad, the name of the other was Medad.
第26節：但有兩個人仍留在營裡，一個名叫伊利達，一個名叫米達。
Which, I don't know, I always stop at this point just to consider what it would be like to be two brothers with those names, "El-dad" and "Me-dad".
這裡，我不知道，我總會停在這裡想一想，如果有兩個兄弟叫這些名字，「El-dad（這老爸）」和「Me-dad（我老爸）」，會是什麼感覺。
The two men remained in the camp, one Eldad, the other Medad.
這兩個人仍留在營裡，一個名叫伊利達，另一個名叫米達。
Now they were among those listed, but who had not gone to the tabernacle; yet they prophesied in the camp.
他們也是在那些被記錄的人中，卻沒有到會幕那裡去；然而他們就在營裡說預言。
Let me stop there just for a moment.
I love this part of the story because it shows what happens when you are covenant-related and connected to other people is you actually receive what they receive.
我很喜歡故事的這個部分，因為它展現了當你與其他人有立約的關係並連結在一起時，你實際上就會領受到他們所領受的。
There's an inheritance that is actually not just given to individuals, but is actually given to families.
有一種產業，實際上不只是賜給個人的，而是賜給整個家族的。
We've got seventy guys surrounding the tabernacle; there's two that for some reason didn't get the memo, they didn't show up.
我們有七十個人圍繞著會幕；有兩個人不知為什麼沒有收到通知，他們沒有出現。
沒收到通知、搞不清楚狀況
The Spirit of God falls upon the seventy, they begin to prophesy, and yet back at camp simultaneously, these two guys began to prophesy under the same anointing.
神的靈降在那七十個人身上，他們開始說預言，然而同時在營裡，這兩個人也在相同的恩膏下開始說預言。
Why? I don't understand how this works, but I love that it does.
為什麼？我不明白這是怎麼運作的，但我很愛它就是會這樣。
The fact that you can be in relationship with people, and when they get a breakthrough, their breakthrough is yours.
事實是，你可以與人建立關係，當他們經歷突破時，他們的突破就是你的。
You can live in drought conditions and think it's normal.
你可以生活在乾旱的情況中，還以為這是正常的。
You can move to Redding, and if we have ten inches of rain a year, and when it's raining, you think, "This isn't a drought, it's raining."
你可以搬到雷丁（Redding），如果我們一年只有十英吋的雨量，而當下雨的時候，你會想：「這不是乾旱，現在正在下雨啊。」
But we actually need 35 to 40 inches a year to keep all of our vegetation, our trees, everything alive and healthy.
但我們實際上一年需要35到40英吋的雨量，才能讓我們所有的植被、樹木、一切都保持存活和健康。
So if you live here, if you come here when we're at ten inches a year because it's a drought, you may think that that's normal.
所以如果你住在這裡，如果你是在我們因為乾旱而一年只有十英吋雨量的時候來，你可能會認為那是正常的。
But what you don't know is that when you're in covenant, normal is 35 to 40 inches of rain a year.
但你不知道的是，當你在約中，「正常」是一年35到40英吋的雨量。
The point is, there are things that you get in covenant with people that you can't ever access when you're independent and on your own.
重點是，在與人的約中，你會得到一些當你獨立、靠自己時，永遠無法獲得的東西。
And even though you think it's full, it's not full; it's not near what it could be.
即使你覺得已經滿了，但其實沒有滿；這遠不及它可能達到的豐盛。
There's something about connecting with people in accountability, in relationship, in pursuit of the same things; something happens.
當你與人連結，在當責中、在關係中、在追求相同事物的過程中，就會發生一些奇妙的事。
Tom Jones, Randy Clark's right-hand guy, had a real stunning and bizarre encounter with the Lord in Brazil a number of years ago.
湯姆·瓊斯（Tom Jones），藍迪·克拉克（Randy Clark）的得力助手，幾年前在巴西與神有了一次非常令人震驚且奇特的相遇。
If I remember right, it lasted all night long; it certainly lasted a very, very long time.
如果我沒記錯的話，這經歷持續了整晚；它確實持續了非常、非常長的時間。
And it was one of those kinds that are written about in Scripture, I mean it was extreme, forever changed his life.
那是聖經裡記載的那種經歷，我的意思是它非常極端，永遠改變了他的生命。
Unknown to him, at the exact same time, while he's in Brazil having this encounter with the Lord, his wife is driving down the freeway, I believe in Florida.
他不知道的是，就在同一個時間，當他在巴西與神有這奇遇的時候，他的妻子正開車行駛在高速公路上，我相信是在佛羅里達州。
And she has to pull off to the side of the road because she simultaneously is having the same encounter with the Lord.
她必須把車停靠在路邊，因為她同時也正在經歷相同的與神相遇。
She has to pull off of the road because of this encounter.
因為這經歷，她必須把車停靠在路邊。
That's the benefit and the purpose of relationship.
這就是關係的益處和目的。
It doesn't give us the liberty to withdraw and to be careless and not associating.
這並沒有給我們自由去退縮、變得隨隨便便，或是不與人結交。

But it does mean that for the spouse of the student in School of Ministry that isn't able to attend the meetings, something is happening in your life that is equal to the one who sits in the class every day receiving the impartation prayer.
但這確實意味著，對於事奉學校學生的配偶，若他們無法參加聚會，在你的生命中正在發生的事，就等同於那個每天坐在教室裡領受分賜禱告的人。
There's something about the relationship that makes you, qualifies you to receive the same thing even though you're not in the room.
這關係裡有一種奇妙的力量，使你、也使你有資格去領受相同的事物，即使你並不在現場。
